title: Nvidia Reportedly Nears $12.9B Hugging Face Deal
summary: Conflicting reports say Nvidia has agreed, or is close, to acquire the central hub of the open-model ecosystem for $12.9 billion.
body:
## The reported transaction

Nvidia is reportedly closing in on a $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, the platform that hosts models, datasets and developer applications central to the open AI ecosystem. TechCrunch cited The Information as reporting an agreement, while also noting a conflicting Business Insider account that said no contract had been signed and negotiations could still collapse. Neither company had publicly confirmed the transaction when the reports appeared.

The proposed price is almost three times Hugging Face’s $4.5 billion valuation in its 2023 financing. TechCrunch reported that the company was generating about $150 million in annual revenue and approaching profitability, making the valuation primarily a bet on its strategic position rather than its current cash flow. Nvidia already participated in Hugging Face’s previous financing and has cultivated a growing catalog of open models, datasets and development tools on the platform.

## What Nvidia would acquire

Hugging Face is more than a model repository. It provides libraries, hosted inference, training services and Spaces for deploying interactive applications. Ownership would give Nvidia a direct relationship with developers choosing models and compute, along with a marketplace through which spare or committed cloud capacity could be distributed.

That creates an unresolved governance question. Hugging Face has operated as a relatively neutral meeting point for models optimized across Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Apple and other hardware. Control by the dominant AI-chip supplier could prompt rivals and some community projects to reconsider how much infrastructure, metadata and distribution they place on the platform.

## Why it matters

If completed, the deal would vertically integrate the leading AI-accelerator vendor with the most influential open-model distribution layer. It could strengthen funding and infrastructure for open AI while simultaneously weakening the platform’s perceived independence. Because the reports disagree about whether an agreement is signed, the immediate fact is a late-stage negotiation—not a completed acquisition.
title_zh: 英伟达据报接近129亿美元收购Hugging Face
summary_zh: 多家媒体对交易是否已经签约说法不一，但均指向英伟达正推进收购开放模型生态核心平台Hugging Face。
body_zh:
## 交易仍待双方确认

英伟达据报正接近以129亿美元收购Hugging Face。后者托管大量模型、数据集和开发者应用，是开放AI生态最重要的基础平台之一。TechCrunch援引The Information称双方已经达成协议，但同时指出Business Insider获得的信息并不一致：合同尚未签署，谈判仍可能破裂。截至相关报道发布时，两家公司都没有公开确认交易。

这一报价接近Hugging Face在2023年融资估值45亿美元的三倍。TechCrunch称，该公司近期年化收入约为1.5亿美元，已接近盈利。因此，129亿美元主要体现的是其生态入口和战略位置，而非现有收入规模。英伟达本身就是Hugging Face此前的投资者，也一直在平台上扩充开放模型、数据集和开发工具。

## 芯片巨头争夺模型分发入口

Hugging Face并非单纯的模型下载站。它还提供开发库、托管推理、训练服务，以及用于发布交互应用的Spaces。若完成收购，英伟达将直接连接开发者选择模型、算力和部署方式的全过程，也可能借助这一渠道消化其承诺采购或担保的云计算容量。

交易同时会引出平台中立性问题。Hugging Face长期承载针对英伟达、AMD、英特尔、苹果等不同硬件优化的项目。若平台由占据主导地位的AI芯片供应商控制，竞争对手及部分开源团队可能重新评估是否继续将模型、使用数据和分发渠道集中于此。

## 为何重要

若交易最终落地，全球领先的AI加速器厂商将与最具影响力的开放模型分发层形成纵向整合。这可能为开放AI带来更多资金和算力，也可能削弱Hugging Face作为中立公共平台的可信度。鉴于媒体对签约状态仍有冲突，目前更准确的表述是双方进入后期谈判，而不是收购已经完成。

cat_take_en: The $12.9 billion buys open AI’s default doorway, but ownership could make that doorway far less neutral.
